additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0460939-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T2170004473] Backend support URL / OCPP1.6J CRM:02888000567
additional_info.body:
Hello Mr. Wild,
I am reaching out to you as Backend Integrator the Customer Service team at Siemens eMobility HQ.
Based on my understanding of your request, you are seeking for support to correctly configure and connect your Backend to a Sicharge D, as well as to perform test scenarios to ensure interoperability between the two systems. To proceed, could you please let me know the name of your OCPP Backend?
From your description, this appears to be a case where an OCPP Integration service is required. Allow me to briefly outline our standard process and recommended next steps: for Integration support and test scenario request, the initial point of contact should be a representative from Siemens Regional Company RC-DE.
I have aligned internally and understand that Simon Evenblij should be your first contact point in this case. Please Simon correct me if this is not accurate, and kindly redirect me to the appropriate colleague to support MAN Trucks.
We can organize a MS Teams call, together with Simon, where we will explain you what the next steps will be, what are the goals and the outcome of an OCPP Integration test service.
In the meanwhile, I forward to both you and Simon our Sharepoint
link
for Backend Integration, and most importantly our
webform
, so that we can understand the activities requested and the efforts required even before our alignment call.
Thank you for reaching out to us and looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com

Thank you.

Yes, that’s exactly correct. We want to establish a connection between the backend and Sicharge D using the OCCP1.6J. Specifically, this concerns the configuration of your URL, which we need in order to conduct various test scenarios regarding bidirectional charging between our e-truck and your Siemens charging station.
I would be happy to contact Mr. Evenblij to organize and conduct a joint MS Teams meeting with you. Would it still be possible for you to schedule an MS Teams appointment this week? My colleagues and I would then adjust to your timing and take your proposed time.
Thank you in advance for your support, and we are looking forward to meeting you at a joint MS Teams meeting.
Best Regards
Matthias

additional_info.body:
BEI Integration planned for 19.02.2026.
Catalina is discussing with PLM and SI E EU DE who should cover the costs.

additional_info.subject: Status Update
additional_info.body:
Status update:
09.02.2026: first alignment between Siemens and MAN Truck & Buses, and establishment of test case scenarios for BEI
19.02.2026: integration test performed on charger RVP/T2170004473 in Munich. Outcome of this test was a list of 5 open points for the completion of the BEI:
Change Configuration & Change Availability
– not implemented yet from Backend side
Local Authorization
– not relevant on 19.02.2026 to authenticate with RFID
Remote Start/Stop Transaction
– not successful during test. Further testing required.
SetChargingProfile -
not successful during test. Further testing required.
Status “Charging” missing –
Identified incorrect behavior from Charger side – Further testing required.
02.03.2026: second alignment between Siemens and MAN Truck & Buses. Connected the charger back to previous Backend (vCharM) in order to remove power limitation and charge at 400kW.
Topic is handled separately via email chain as Backend Integration, no need to keep ticket open.
